clips.prompt_text: Listen carefully to the attached 12-second soundtrack segment and use the timestamped still images only to disambiguate audible sources. Create non-speech captions for the audio that is actually present. Do not caption silent visible actions. Do not infer character emotions, motives, dialogue or physical events from images alone. Background music is valid; mention sound effects only if audible. Use restrained factual wording. Return a JSON object with a cues array and an uncertainties array, without markdown. For each cue give start_s and end_s as local seconds between 0 and 12.000; sound_key as a short lowercase-hyphenated category (use music for score); confidence as high, medium or low; label as a very short sound label of 1-5 words; concise as an audible description of 4-9 words; detailed as the fullest audio-supported description of 7-16 words; scene_context as a short factual description of the visible scene; and scene_load as exactly quiet, balanced or dense. Maximum 5 cues. Music can span the clip. Effects need their own estimated onset/end. If uncertain omit the effect or name its broad acoustic quality. All text must describe this specific attached clip; do not repeat these instructions. No fictional embellishment. Language: English.

If uncertain, mark low. No markdown or instructions in the output.
